programmes.t: Once Upon a Time in America
programmes.d: Sergio Leone's final film is the epic tale of the life of a Jewish gangster in New York.
Lions For Lambs tells the poignant and layered story of several individuals caught up at various ends of the U.S. War on terror.
Travis Henderson, an aimless drifter who has been missing for four years, wanders out of the desert and must reconnect with society, himself, his life, and his family.
A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.
Harvey Keitel and Madonna star in this captivating and controversial film about a director whose brutal honesty in portraying an abusive marriage begins to seep off of the set and into real life.

Seduction, passion and power struggles unfold as the creators of Basic Instinct blow the lid off the seemingly glamorous world of Las Vegas showdancing in this controversial film that stars Elizabeth Berkley.

Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

In this suspenseful thriller, Mickey Rourke is an escaped killer who forces his way into a family's home while waiting for his accomplice (Kelly Lynch) to take him to Mexico. Also featuring Mimi Rogers and Anthony Hopkins.
